snippet.title: X-YZE Trailer | Bump Combat Action
snippet.description:
DOWNLOAD FOR FREE on itch: https://chrislsound.itch.io/x-yze
ORIGINAL SOUNDTRACK: https://chrislogsdon.bandcamp.com/album/x-yze-original-game-soundtrack

shutdown sequence interrupted...
memories wiped...can't speak...
voice in head...ordered to kill...
awaking in prison...what's going on?

X-YZE (pronounced "excise") is a bump combat action game with a mysterious short story narrative.

Game by Chris Logsdon: https://chrislsound.itch.io/

Trailer by Alix Lytton: https://alixesque.itch.io/
